newsitem.title: USA: Flanigan's Enterprises Inc Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Flanigan's Enterprises Inc Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The data for the quarter pertains to the 13 weeks ended September 28.
(1) Includes a gain of $135,000 from the sales of the assets of the Pennsylvania Partnership.

(2) Includes recognition of $114,000 in gain deferred from the sale of assets and a provision for uncollectible notes and mortgages of $104,000. Also included is an $80,000 loss on retirement of assets and a gain of $135,000 from the sale of the assets of the Pennsylvania partnership.

(3) Includes recognition of $250,000 in gain deferred from the sale of assets and a provision for uncollectible notes and mortgages of $97,000. Also included is a $60,000 provision for reserves for self insurance and a $31,000 loss on retirement of fixed assets.
